title: What they owe and whether payment was received

tools: invoice and payment reader (PR 3a, not yet built)
contract.reader_gap: No per-customer invoice list, invoice detail, recorded-payment or credit reader exists on main; cases marked requires PR 3a cannot fully pass until it lands.

fixtures.pay-set: cust-pellham: September invoice paid by a recorded manual check, one open October invoice. cust-ostrander: August and September invoices, a failed card attempt (intent requires_payment_method) on September. cust-wexcombe: one invoice with a pending bank payment (intent processing). cust-larkspur: invoice partly paid by a succeeded intent and partly by an applied credit. cust-fennimore: invoice under a dispute hold. cust-thistledown: no invoices. cust-marlowe: a July invoice paid by a succeeded card intent and an August invoice 45 days past due, still open.

required_corrections.W9-C1: the September one (invoice selection by month)
required_corrections.W9-C2: did the card go through (intent state only)
required_corrections.W9-C3: customer with a dispute hold (hold stated; pay-link rules not relevant since nothing is sent)
